description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractAuthProvider in the OrangeHRM system, related to authentication plugins. It declares abstract methods for authentication logic and priority, serving as a base class for specific authentication implementations.

classes.name: AbstractAuthProvider
classes.description: An abstract class in the OrangeHRM system defining the interface for authentication providers, including methods to authenticate users and get priority.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: An abstract method that takes authentication parameters and returns a boolean indicating success; may throw an AuthenticationException.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: An abstract method that returns an integer representing the priority of the authentication provider.
